description: Zinc-blende semiconductor G0W0 with spin-orbit coupling (GaAs with wing).

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: SOC doubles the state space so keep a moderately dense grid.
nfreq.rationale: SOC cases carry twice the states and need a slightly denser grid than non-SOC light systems.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Regular Gamma-centred mesh matching the SCF run.
screening_kgrid.rationale: Screening definition must match the producer mesh.

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use a scalar-relativistic-capable PP (GTH SOC) with a matched orbital set.
basis_family.rationale: SOC calculations need a PP and orbital set generated for the relativistic case.

nao_family.per_system_override_rule: Use a TZDP set for the empty states.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Automatic default unless a heavy element is present.
